action: In general, a standard system update will make all the necessary changes.
description:
Wolfgang Schweer discovered that Debian-LAN configured overly permissive
ACLs for the Kerberos admin server. An authenticated user could possibly
use this issue to change the credentials of other users, leading to
privilege escalation.
isummary:
Debian-LAN could allow users to change the Kerberos passwords of other
users.

debian-lan-config.description: FAI config space and other configs for the Debian-LAN system

title: Debian-LAN vulnerability
